remarks: Walk to town 3bd, 2.5 bath townhouse. Well maintained complex of 4 units. Eat in Kitchen, combined living room and dining room with slider to a flagstone patio. LR/DR has a gas fireplace. Primary bedroom with bath, 2 other bedrooms share guest hall bath. Hardwood floors throughout. Walk to downtown's fine shops, restaurants and train. Tenant pays all utilities, no water utility, on well. $450 Annual sewer fee. Professional landlord maintains exterior, landscaping, snow removal. CAT Only. Credit Check required, good credit a must. no Guarantor signers. 4 hour notice to show. Occupancy negotiable starting Oct 15. Broker is member of LLC,
